The main takeaway from our work is that
a geostatistical model is only as good as the data it can explain.
the geostatistical models need to be conditioned on the geophysical data to be able to make reliable statements about the spatial distribution of hydraulic conductivity at the MADE site.
the geostatistical description of the subsurface should not be based solely on the geostatistical properties of a given site, but should also be informed by the spatial resolution of available data.
